name: NIGHTSEND
detailed_description:
Nightsend is a cyberpunk strategy-RPG where you battle to reclaim your identity and take back the city. Once a legendary ghost in the machine, you were digitally erased by a powerful corporate AI. Now, you’re starting from nothing—assembling a base, recruiting allies, and running high-risk missions to rebuild your influence in the shadows of Metro City.

KEY FEATURES

  • Build and Upgrade Your HQ

    Construct rooms, unlock upgrades, and manage your resources in a grid-based, vertical tower layout.

  • Heists and Story Missions

    Strategically plan and execute missions—from stealthy data grabs to all-out shootouts.

  • 2.5D Combat Sequences

    Dive into side-scrolling boss battles and action segments that punctuate key story moments.

  • Recruit and Train Your Crew

    Each crew member brings unique skills to your team. Train them, upgrade their abilities, and take them into battle.

  • A Deep Cyberpunk Narrative

    Navigate a branching story filled with betrayal, rogue AIs, underground factions, and morally gray decisions.

  • Stylish Visuals and Synth-Driven Soundtrack

    Immerse yourself in a gritty, neon-soaked world inspired by retro-futurism and synthwave aesthetics.

Your past was deleted. Your legend is just beginning. Welcome to Nightsend.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains content that may not be suitable for all audiences. Nightsend features scenes of stylized violence, depictions of theft, hacking, and property destruction, as well as themes of corporate corruption, rebellion, and survival in a dystopian urban environment. Player actions may involve morally ambiguous choices and interactions with criminal elements.
